extracted.intended_audience: policy makers, regulators, legal researchers, advocates, and members of the public searching Federal Register rulemaking documents related to women
extracted.subtask_description: A paginated API/listing of Federal Register documents (rules, proposed rules, corrections, notices) filtered by the topic "Women," returning titles, abstracts, agencies, and links for each document. Useful for discovering rulemakings and notices related to women's programs, health, benefits, and related regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic prior authorization for drugs
rubrics_metrics.description: Impacted payers (Medicare Advantage organizations, Medicaid FFS programs, Medicaid managed care plans, CHIP entities, and QHP issuers on FFEs/FF‑SHOPs) must make available electronic prior authorization for drugs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed to improve exchange of health care data and streamline prior authorization by increasing interoperability of systems; extends existing electronic prior authorization capabilities to drugs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extend interoperability requirements to drug prior authorizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Existing interoperability requirements for prior authorization of non-drug items and services are proposed to be extended to include prior authorizations for drugs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to further reduce patient and provider burden by applying the same interoperability standards to drug prior authorization workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting API endpoints and related information to CMS
rubrics_metrics.description: Impacted payers would be required to report their API endpoints and related information for Patient Access, Provider Directory, Provider Access, Payer-to-Payer, and Prior Authorization APIs to CMS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporting is proposed so CMS can track and oversee the availability and interoperability of required APIs across payers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collection of API usage metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: CMS proposes collecting API usage metrics from impacted payers to help assess the impact of interoperability policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Usage metrics would be used to evaluate effectiveness and uptake of API and interoperability requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adopt HL7 FHIR base standard and specific implementation guides as standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed adoption of the HL7 FHIR base standard and certain associated specifications and implementation guides (IGs) as HIPAA standards for referral certification and authorization transactions and eligibility transactions associated with prior authorization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also proposes requiring certain recommended FHIR IGs that are currently only recommended, to improve payers' ability to exchange health information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'failure to report' with CMP authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to add a definition for 'failure to report' that would permit CMS to impose civil money penalties on applicable manufacturers or group purchasing organizations that fail to grant CMS timely access to documents for audit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines an enforcement mechanism (CMP) for failure to provide audit access when required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on using 'reputation risk' in supervisory programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Regulators (OCC and FDIC) will be prohibited from criticizing or taking adverse action against an institution on the basis of 'reputation risk.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rule codifies elimination of reputation risk as a basis for supervisory program actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on adverse actions based on political, social, cultural, or religious views
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies may not require, instruct, encourage, or take adverse action (e.g., to close accounts or refrain from providing services) based on a person or entity's political, social, cultural, or religious views or constitutionally protected speech, or solely because of lawful but politically disfavored business activities perceived to present reputation risk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically forbids supervisory steps intended to limit access to financial services or to punish protected speech or lawful activity perceived as risky to reputation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on supervisory punishment for lawful activities or protected speech
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies are forbidden from taking supervisory or other adverse actions designed to punish or discourage individuals or groups from engaging in lawful political, social, cultural, or religious activities or constitutionally protected speech.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers actions targeting institutions, groups of institutions, or institution-affiliated parties intended to chill lawful expression or activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revised bank appeals procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish revised procedures and policies for appeals of material supervisory determinations by OCC-supervised entities to enhance independence and efficiency of the appeals function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed rule reflects OCC experience administering the bank appeals process and aims to improve the appeals framework.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civil money penalties for noncompliant issuers
rubrics_metrics.description: The HHS proposed/final rules include civil money penalties (CMPs) provisions for issuers and responsible entities that do not comply with specified Exchange and market standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMPs are used as enforcement tools for various types of issuer noncompliance described in benefit/payment parameter rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards and evidentiary tests for agents, brokers, and web‑brokers
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules revise or establish standards governing the conduct of agents, brokers, and web-brokers and set evidentiary standards HHS uses to assess their potential noncompliance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes system suspension authority and other compliance tools aimed at entities assisting consumers with Exchange enrollment and enrollment assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provider access and Essential Community Provider (ECP) standards for QHP certification
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards governing provider access and ECP requirements that QHPs must meet for certification are revised/established in Notices of Benefit and Payment Parameters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Changes affect how issuers demonstrate network adequacy and ECP participation for QHP certification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on including routine non‑pediatric dental services as an Essential Health Benefit
rubrics_metrics.description: Issuers subject to EHB requirements are prohibited from including specified routine non‑pediatric dental services as an Essential Health Benefit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This limits what services can be designated as EHB within applicable benefit standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost‑sharing flexibilities for catastrophic and individual market bronze plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules provide cost‑sharing flexibility options for catastrophic plans and individual market bronze plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to provide plan design flexibility while maintaining applicable consumer protections and actuarial value thresholds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish catastrophic plans with multi‑year terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal/final rule allows establishment of catastrophic plans with plan terms of up to 10 consecutive years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extends permissible plan-term configurations for catastrophic coverage under market rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: QHP issuer Quality Improvement Strategy (QIS) requirements and public reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: QHP issuers are required/encouraged to implement quality improvement strategies; HHS proposes to publicly share aggregated, summary-level QIS information annually.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy aims to improve issuer quality practices and transparency through aggregated reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modifications to HHS‑RADV audits and validation methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: Changes to the risk adjustment and risk adjustment data validation (HHS-RADV) program, including modifications to Initial Validation Audit (IVA) sampling approach and Second Validation Audit (SVA) pairwise means testing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical revisions intended to refine audit sampling and validation tests used in risk adjustment.

rubrics_metrics.name: HHS authority to conduct compliance reviews and enforce against lead agents
rubrics_metrics.description: HHS rulemakings clarify authority to engage in compliance reviews of and take enforcement action against lead agents of insurance agencies for violations of Exchange standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides enforcement pathways against entities that are responsible for compliance failures in enrollment or Exchange operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optional fixed‑dollar premium payment threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: A proposed/implemented optional fixed-dollar premium payment threshold that may be applied within Exchange operations or eligibility frameworks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An alternative threshold option to percentage-based affordability or payment rules; intended to provide states/issuers some flexibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plan‑level index rate adjustment for cost‑sharing reductions (CSRs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Permits a permissible plan-level adjustment to the index rate to account for CSR-related differences in plan costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows actuarial adjustments to reflect the cost of CSRs while maintaining rate-setting consistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconsideration standards for certification denials
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards governing the reconsideration process for denials of QHP certification or other program certifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines procedural and substantive benchmarks for reconsideration reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public sharing of aggregated QIS information
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy to publicly share aggregated, summary-level Quality Improvement Strategy information on an annual basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports transparency and public accountability for issuer quality improvement efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revisions to Medical Loss Ratio (MLR) reporting and rebate requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed/final adjustments to MLR reporting obligations and rebate calculation/reporting requirements for qualifying issuers meeting certain standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Affect issuer reporting and potential rebate liabilities under the MLR framework.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updates to Department of Energy Acquisition Regulation (DEAR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive revisions to DEAR to update and streamline policies, procedures, provisions, and clauses applicable to DOE contracts; remove obsolete or duplicative coverage and retain only provisions that implement or supplement FAR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes adding new clauses and amending existing ones to promote uniform application of DOE contract award and administration policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adoption of OMB Uniform Administrative Requirements with HHS modifications
rubrics_metrics.description: HHS adopts OMB's Uniform Administrative Requirements, Cost Principles, and Audit Requirements for Federal Awards, including specified HHS‑specific modifications, and repeals existing HHS financial assistance administration regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes incorporation of uniform guidance into HHS regulatory framework and correction of citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: WOSB program definitions and statutory conformance
rubrics_metrics.description: Final rule adds definitions and conforms Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB) Federal Contract Program regulations to current statutes not previously integrated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes adoption of language consistent with other SBA contracting programs to improve clarity and legal alignment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for qualifying individual's control and limits on outside employment (WOSB)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules adopt requirements regarding the qualifying individual's control of an applicant concern and limits on outside employment to ensure control and eligibility standards are met.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mirrors language used in SBA's other contracting program regulations and clarifies control and employment expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: WOSB application certification review process changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Changes to the process by which SBA reviews applications for certification to implement statutory amendments regarding the effects of a status determination on a small business concern.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alters administrative procedures for status determinations and their consequences for contracting eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include DACA recipients and certain noncitizens in 'lawfully present' definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Final rule updates eligibility definitions to include Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) recipients and certain other noncitizens as 'lawfully present' for purposes of QHP enrollment, Advance Payments of the Premium Tax Credit (APTC), Cost‑Sharing Reductions (CSRs), and Basic Health Program eligibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies and expands who is considered lawfully present for insurance affordability and enrollment programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for denial of coverage for failure to pay past‑due premium
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules revise standards applicable to denial of coverage for failure to pay past‑due premiums and related procedural safeguards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies how and when coverage may be denied on premium payment grounds and associated evidentiary or notice requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibit coverage of specified sex‑trait modification procedures as EHB
rubrics_metrics.description: Issuers subject to EHB requirements are prohibited from including coverage for specified sex‑trait modification procedures as an Essential Health Benefit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limits scope of EHBs with respect to certain procedures identified in Marketplace Integrity and Affordability rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Define 'unsafe or unsound practice' and revise supervisory communications framework
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed definition of 'unsafe or unsound practice' for purposes of section 8 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act and a revised supervisory framework for issuance of 'matters requiring attention' and other supervisory communications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies supervisory terminology and modifies procedures for supervisory communications and required actions by institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: WIC food package alignment with Dietary Guidelines and NASEM recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: Revises WIC food packages to align with current Dietary Guidelines for Americans and reflect National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine recommendations while promoting nutrition security and equity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to provide a wider variety of foods consistent with latest nutritional science, offer State flexibility to tailor packages for special dietary needs and cultural preferences, provide amounts consistent with WIC's supplemental purpose, encourage fruit and vegetable consumption, and strengthen breastfeeding support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarify protections for beneficiaries and obligations of faith‑based/neighborhood organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Amend agency regulations to clarify protections for beneficiaries of federally funded social services and the rights and obligations of organizations (including faith-based and neighborhood organizations) providing such services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aims to promote maximum participation by beneficiaries and providers and ensure consistent program implementation in accordance with the Executive Order establishing the White House Office of Faith-Based and Neighborhood Partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: System suspension authority for noncompliant agents and brokers
rubrics_metrics.description: HHS proposes or codifies system suspension authority to address noncompliance by agents and brokers assisting consumers in Exchanges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides an operational enforcement mechanism to suspend entities from Exchange systems when they fail to comply with standards or present risks to consumers.
